story_text: As a user, I want to update multiple fields of a task in a single request so that I can edit efficiently.

positive.title: Update title, priority, and category simultaneously
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with valid title, priority, and category fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all three fields updated in response

positive.title: Verify updated fields persist via GET request
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{task_id}.
2. Verify response reflects all updated fields.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · response reflects all updated fields

positive.title: Update with valid fields and verify response structure
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with valid fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · response includes updated task object with correct field values

positive.title: Update all fields including description and status
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with all fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all fields updated in response

positive.title: Update title and priority, leaving category unchanged
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with title and priority fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · title and priority updated, category remains unchanged

negative.title: Update with invalid field names
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with invalid field names in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message

negative.title: Update with one valid field and one invalid field
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with one valid and one invalid field in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · neither field updated (atomic behaviour)

negative.title: Update multiple fields on a non-existent task
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with multiple fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 404 Not Found · error body includes descriptive message

negative.title: Update fields without Authentication
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with valid fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 401 Unauthorized · error body includes descriptive message

negative.title: Update other user's task
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with valid fields in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
negative.expected_result: 403 Forbidden · error body includes descriptive message

edge.title: Update with null values for valid fields
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with valid field names but null values in the body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 200 OK with no changes — must be defined behaviour for null values

edge.title: Update with empty request body
steps: 1. Send PATCH request to /tasks/{task_id} with an empty body.
2. Verify response status code and body.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · error body includes descriptive message
